title: Offset/limit pagination — Record Pagination Controller
description: OFFSET skips rows and LIMIT takes a page; page p of size s is OFFSET (p-1)*s LIMIT s. It is simple and universal across SQL databases. Offset pagination underlies most list UIs.
demo:
# Pagination: offset/limit pages plus page-window navigation metadata.
records = ["rec-%02d" % i for i in range(1, 23 + 1)]
page, size = 2, 5
total_pages = (len(records) + size - 1) // size
page = max(1, min(page, total_pages))
start = (page - 1) * size
items = records[start:start + size]
window = [p for p in range(max(1, page-2), min(total_pages, page+2) + 1)]
print(f"Page {page}/{total_pages} (size {size}, total {len(records)}): {items}")
print("window:", window, "| has_prev:", page > 1, "| has_next:", page < total_pages)
provenance: Public methodology — standard computer-science technique documented in the technical literature; fact-checked 2026-10-21.
